Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. While in battle, adds one destiny to total power. Immune to Come With Me, Life Debt, and attrition < 6.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-12-2023.pdf#page=1 Errata-12-2023.pdf], page 1 (PDF dated 11 December 2023). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
